'''Kullbee Sperado''' was a [[Gender|male]]<ref name="ROUVG" /> [[Meftian]]<ref name="Guardians of the Whills" /> [[gunslinger]] who was recruited by rebel leader [[Saw Gerrera]] to join his [[Partisans]] while on [[Serolonis|Serralonis]].

==Biography==
[[File:KullbeeSperado-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|Sperado piloting an X-wing fighter for the Partisans.]]
Kullbee Sperado was recruited by rebel leader [[Saw Gerrera]] to join his [[Partisans]] while on [[Serolonis|Serralonis]]. Running from a past that he refused to speak about, he was intensely private and would disappear for [[Standard week|weeks]] at a time.<ref name="ROUVG" /> 

Later in [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Narkina Trivia">{{AndorDate|108}}</ref><ref name="5 BBY">{{AndorDate|111}}</ref> Tenza and the Partisans were stationed at a [[Saw Gerrera's Base|base]] on the [[planet]]<ref name="Narkina 5 AD">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> [[Segra Milo]]. During two separate occasions, Tenza stood in the base while the rebel [[Luthen Rael]] spoke with Gerrera inside.<ref name="Narkina 5">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref><ref name="Daughter of Ferrix">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}</ref>

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> he and the rest of the Partisans were based in the [[Catacombs of Cadera]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]], where Sperado was sometimes spotted praying at the [[Temple of the Kyber]] in [[Jedha City]].<ref name="ROUVG" />

Shortly after the Partisans captured a group including Gerrera's adoptive daughter [[Jyn Erso]] in the [[city]], they were forced to evacuate from the catacombs after the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] Jedha City, creating a blast wave that also destroyed the catacombs.<ref name="RO" /> Some time after surviving these events, Sperado and [[Cycyed Ock]] found their way to the opposite hemisphere of the moon. After discovering a smuggler's guide left behind by [[Shesslaria]], the two left Jedha in hopes of finding [[Maz Kanata]]'s treasure on [[Iskalon]]. While initially seizing the treasure, they were soon captured and thrown into [[Megalox]] Beta Penitentiary.<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kullbee Sperado first appeared in the film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="RO" /> which was released in North America on [[December 16]], [[2016]].<ref name="Director Announced">{{SW|url=news/gareth-edwards-and-gary-whitta-onboard-for-star-wars-stand-alone-film|text=Gareth Edwards and Gary Whitta Onboard for ''Star Wars'' Stand-Alone Film}}</ref> He was not identified in the film, but received a name in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="ROUVG" /> and released the same day.<ref name="DK">{{DK|url=us/9781465452634-star-wars-rogue-one-the-ultimate-visual-guide|text=Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> He was portrayed by [[Robert Nairne]], who also played [[Cycyed Ock]] in the film.<ref name="RO" />

Sperado's name is a combination of his production nickname, "Skullbeard," with the word "desperado" because he looked like a gunslinger from the [[Wikipedia:American Frontier|Old West]].<ref name="Much to Learn">{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-talking-rogue-one-aliens-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: Talking ''Rogue One'' Aliens with Pablo Hidalgo}}</ref>
